title: MCP hook points
description: The JSON form of this extension's hook points: <point>_input carries the kernel hook environment, <point>_output is what a hook answers.

mcp_elicitation_input.description: A server's request for user input during a call, in the session that made the call.

requested_schema.description: The form's JSON Schema, in form mode.

url.description: The page to open, in url mode; always https.

mcp_elicitation_output.description: The user's answer; content goes back to the server only, never to the model.
